review: So. I did not know this was here. Eleven of us go to the Polish Mass and the priest is retiring and when he goes it goes, and my son is seventeen and will not come, and I have been fighting that quietly for three years. Then I find this. "Kochani Przed Słońcem" — loved before the sun. In Polish. On an American website. I played it in the kitchen without saying what it was and my son stayed in the room for the whole song. He did not comment. He stayed. Five stars. My mother died in Kraków while I was on a shift I could not leave and I have not been able to sing anything in Polish since, and I sang this one.
